title: EFC — A Deep Dive into the Halo Concept
abstract: Conceptual overview of the halo in cosmology, emphasizing its role as a stabilizer and regulator of energy and mass flow around galaxies and clusters. Synthesizes evidence from rotation curves, gravitational lensing, X-ray intracluster emissions, and simulations to motivate halos as dynamic, dark-matter-dominated envelopes that preserve structure and large-scale symmetry within the Energy-Flow Cosmology framing.
